Gholdengo

Steel Ghost

Paldea · Generation 9

Gholdengo is a Steel/Ghost-type Coin Entity Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 30 kg. It evolves from Gimmighoul. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (133), with a base stat total of 550.
